comingLast.roast: on 22 - the presentation MC has started clearing his throat
on 18 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
finished 1 clear of the blue balls - now buying Paul drinks out of gratitude
safety margin 1 - his playing partners call it 'the plank'
in on a cushion of 2 - refreshing the board between sips
2 clear from the bar stool - the best kind of clear
done and dangling 2 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe-ish by 2 - the blue balls have come back from further
finished 3 above Paul - close enough to keep his speech drafted
finished with a 3-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
safe by 3 unless the course gets generous late
